name: Cube-Chordal Ample Classes Are Contained in Cube-Inward Representable Ample Classes
scope: Finite nonempty ample classes under the signed-coordinate and full ambient complement conventions; hierarchy parameters are held fixed.
statement: Every member of Cube-Chordal Ample Classes belongs to Cube-Inward Representable Ample Classes.
proof: Peel while retaining the specified contained cube and extend any map of that cube by literal corner extension.
